newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hilton Hotels, BP "recommended".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hilton Hotels, BP "recommended".

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said its chief equity strategist David Shulman added Hilton Hotels Corp and British Petroleum Co Plc to the firm's recommended list.
-- The brokerage said in a summary report that Hilton's shares have lagged those of its rivals.
-- Salomon believes analysts continue to underestimate the price of oil and sees "upside surprises" coming in the energy sector in the 1997 first half, the report said.
-- Hilton was off 1/4 to 26-1/8 and British Petroleum rose 1-3/4 to 142-5/8 in New York Stock Exchange trading.
